options.name: accessor_id
options.description: Specifies a UUID to use as the token's Accessor ID. If not specified a UUID is generated for this field.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The CA bundle to use for https connections.

options.name: description
options.description: Free form human readable description of the token.

options.name: expiration_ttl
options.description: This is a convenience field and if set it initializes the C(expiration_time). Can be specified in the form of V(60s) or V(5m) (that is, 60 seconds or 5 minutes, respectively). Ingored when the token is updated!

options.name: local
options.description: If true, indicates that the token should not be replicated globally and instead be local to the current datacenter.

options.name: node_identities
options.description: List of node identities to attach to the token. If not specified, any node identities currently assigned are not changed. If the parameter is an empty array (V([])), any node identities assigned are unassigned.

options.name: policies
options.description: List of policies to attach to the token. Each policy is a dict. If the parameter is left blank, any policies currently assigned are not changed. Any empty array (V([])) clears any policies previously set.

options.name: port
options.description: The port on which the consul agent is running.

options.name: roles
options.description: List of roles to attach to the token. Each role is a dict. If the parameter is left blank, any roles currently assigned are not changed. Any empty array (V([])) clears any roles previously set.

options.name: scheme
options.description: The protocol scheme on which the Consul agent is running. Defaults to V(http) and can be set to V(https) for secure connections.

options.name: secret_id
options.description: Specifies a UUID to use as the token's Secret ID. If not specified a UUID is generated for this field.

options.name: service_identities
options.description: List of service identities to attach to the token. If not specified, any service identities currently assigned are not changed. If the parameter is an empty array (V([])), any node identities assigned are unassigned.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the token should be present or absent.

options.name: templated_policies
options.description: The list of templated policies that should be applied to the role.

options.name: token
options.description: The token to use for authorization.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate of the Consul agent.
